note: REAL evaluation set. Fraud cases are formal retractions from the Retraction Watch database (Crossref) whose stated reason concerns image integrity; PDFs fetched from the PMC Open Access subset. Clean controls are PMC OA papers cross-checked against the FULL Retraction Watch DOI list (all retractions, not just image-related). IMPORTANT: labels are PAPER-LEVEL only — figure_num is null for every fraud case because Retraction Watch does not identify which figure was manipulated. Per-detector, figure-level metrics therefore require manual figure annotation first; paper-level metrics are valid as-is.
